hero.heading: Real Strategy. Quality Content. Transparent Marketing.

servicesIntro.heading: Services That Help Your Business Grow
servicesIntro.subheading: At Sarovar Marketing Hub, we help local businesses and service providers build a stronger digital presence through quality content, organic marketing, and strategic advertising. We believe effective marketing starts with understanding your business, your audience, and what makes your brand different. From creative ideas, engaging hooks, and scriptwriting to video production, editing, and social media management, we handle the process from start to finish. We focus on building a strong organic foundation before investing in paid ads whenever the strategy allows, helping businesses make more informed decisions about their marketing budgets. With transparent communication, thoughtful planning, and a focus on creative quality, we aim to build lasting growth rather than chase empty views or followers. Your business deserves a strategy, not just another ad campaign.

services.title: Organic Content & SMM
services.description: We create content strategies built around your audience, brand, and business goals. From attention-grabbing hooks and engaging scripts to relevant visuals and clear messaging, we help your brand connect with the right people and build a stronger organic presence.
features: Content strategies built around your audience, brand and business goals
A stronger organic presence with the right people

services.title: Social Media Management
services.description: We manage your social media presence with planned content, engaging captions, consistent posting, and a cohesive brand identity. From content calendars to publishing, we help keep your pages active, professional, and aligned with your business goals while you focus on running your business.
features: A cohesive brand identity across your pages

services.title: Meta Ads
services.description: We create and manage Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns with a focus on strong creatives, relevant messaging, and sensible budget allocation. From lead generation to local brand awareness, we test and refine campaigns based on performance, helping you make informed decisions about your advertising spend.
features: Lead generation and local brand awareness
Testing and refining based on performance

services.title: Google Ads
services.description: We help your business reach potential customers through targeted Google Ads campaigns. With relevant keyword research, compelling ad copy, location-based targeting where appropriate, and ongoing performance analysis, we work to connect your business with people searching for your products or services.

services.title: YouTube Ads
services.description: We help businesses promote their products and services through YouTube video advertising. From choosing suitable campaign objectives to developing engaging video creatives and monitoring performance, we focus on reaching relevant audiences and supporting your brand awareness, traffic, or lead-generation goals.
features: Support for brand awareness, traffic or lead-generation goals

services.title: Content Shooting & Editing
services.description: We turn your ideas into engaging Reels, Shorts, and promotional videos through thoughtful scripting, recording guidance, lighting, and professional editing. We can shoot on location or guide you through recording on your own device, then handle the editing and content preparation for publishing.
features: On-location shooting, or guidance for recording on your own device

services.title: Influencer Marketing
services.tagline: Creators who connect you with the right audience
services.description: We help businesses connect with relevant content creators to promote their products and services through authentic, audience-focused campaigns. From influencer selection and campaign planning to content coordination, we focus on building brand awareness, strengthening trust, and reaching potential customers more effectively.
features: Building brand awareness and strengthening trust

services.title: Web & Mobile App Development
services.tagline: Websites that turn visitors into customers
services.description: At Sarovar Marketing Hub, we help businesses establish a strong online presence through modern, responsive, and user-friendly websites. In partnership with [Wrath Labs](https://wrathlabs.in), we offer website design and development solutions tailored to your business goals, focusing on clean design, smooth functionality, and an experience that helps turn visitors into potential customers.
features: Design and development tailored to your business goals
An experience that helps turn visitors into potential customers

services.title: SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
services.tagline: Be found by people already looking
services.description: We help businesses improve their search engine visibility and attract relevant organic traffic through strategic SEO. In collaboration with [Wrath Labs](https://wrathlabs.in), we offer services including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and local SEO to help your business reach potential customers and build a stronger long-term online presence.

services.title: Performance Marketing
services.tagline: Paid campaigns planned around your goals
services.description: We plan paid campaigns around one question: what does your business actually need from its marketing? We set clear goals, track the right numbers, and review results regularly so your budget goes where it works best. We build on your organic foundation first whenever the strategy allows, and we explain every decision along the way.
features: Clear goals set before any budget is spent
Tracking of the numbers that matter to your business

process.heading: From first call to first result
process.subheading: Same four steps whether you hire us for one channel or all six.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.description: 30 minutes on your goals, numbers and constraints. You leave with at least one thing to fix, hired or not.

steps.title: Audit & proposal
steps.description: We audit your accounts and come back with a scoped plan, timeline and a fixed monthly number.

steps.title: Onboard & launch
steps.description: Access, tracking and creative in week one. First campaigns and content live inside two weeks.

steps.title: Review & scale
steps.description: Weekly iteration, monthly reviews. We scale what earns and cut what doesn't, transparently.

packages.heading: Simple, honest pricing
packages.subheading: Retainers scale with scope and ad spend. Every plan includes a named strategist and a shared channel.
packages.note: Prices exclude GST and ad spend. Custom scopes welcome — most of our clients end up with one.
packages.billingNote: Minimum 90-day initial term, then month to month.

items.name: Starter
items.description: For brands establishing presence and testing their first paid channel.

items.name: Growth
items.description: Our most popular plan — full-funnel execution across paid, organic and web.

items.name: Scale
items.description: For established brands needing a full outsourced marketing department.

addOns.heading: Add-ons
addOns.subheading: Bolt any of these onto an existing retainer.

items.title: Content shoot day
items.text: A full day of photo and video capture with direction and edits.

items.title: Marketing audit
items.text: A 30-page teardown of your funnel, ads, site and analytics.

items.title: Email & retention
items.text: Flows, campaigns and segmentation on Klaviyo or Mailchimp.

items.title: Team workshop
items.text: Half-day training so your in-house team can run what we build.

items.question: Can we start with just one service?
items.answer: Absolutely. Most clients start with one channel — usually paid social or SEO — and add services once they trust the process. We'll tell you honestly which single channel we'd start with for your business.

items.question: Is ad spend included in the retainer?
items.answer: No. Ad spend goes directly to Meta, Google or LinkedIn from your own accounts. Our fee covers strategy, creative, management and reporting.

items.question: How much ad budget do we need to start?
items.answer: For meaningful learning we recommend a minimum of ₹1,00,000 per month in spend for performance marketing. Below that, organic and content usually give you better returns first.

items.question: Who owns the creative and accounts?
items.answer: You do — always. Ad accounts, pixels, source files, domains and content libraries stay in your name from day one.

items.question: Do you offer one-off projects?
items.answer: Yes, for branding, websites and launch campaigns. Ongoing channels like SEO and paid media only work as retainers, so we don't sell those as one-offs.

cta.heading: Not sure which service you need?
cta.subheading: That's exactly what the first call is for. Bring your numbers, we'll tell you where the biggest gap is — and what we'd fix first.
